cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TEMPESTPeer VERSION 3.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
if(NOT TARGET TEMPEST::Messaging)
    find_package(TEMPESTMessaging 3 CONFIG QUIET)
    if(NOT TARGET TEMPEST::Messaging)
        add_subdirectory(vendor/messaging ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/messaging)
    endif()
endif()
find_package(cppzmq CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(nlohmann_json CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_library(TEMPESTPeer src/zmq_peer.cpp)
add_library(TEMPEST::Peer ALIAS TEMPESTPeer)
set_target_properties(TEMPESTPeer PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME Peer POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_link_libraries(TEMPESTPeer PUBLIC TEMPEST::Messaging nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json PRIVATE cppzmq)
install(TARGETS TEMPESTPeer EXPORT TEMPESTPeerTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
install(EXPORT TEMPESTPeerTargets NAMESPACE TEMPEST:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake
    INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfigVersion.cmake
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/TEMPESTPeerConfigVersion.cmake
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/TEMPESTPeer)

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    add_executable(TEMPESTPeer_Example EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL examples/peer.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(TEMPESTPeer_Example PRIVATE DARTWIC::EngineProtocolPeer)
    add_executable(TEMPESTProtocolPeer_Example EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL examples/tempest_peer.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(TEMPESTProtocolPeer_Example PRIVATE TEMPEST::Peer)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET DARTWIC::EngineProtocol)
    find_package(DARTWICEngineProtocol 3 CONFIG QUIET)
    if(NOT TARGET DARTWIC::EngineProtocol)
        if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../engine-protocol/CMakeLists.txt")
            add_subdirectory(../engine-protocol ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/engine-protocol)
        else()
            add_subdirectory(vendor/engine-protocol ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/engine-protocol)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
add_library(DARTWICPeerClient INTERFACE)
add_library(DARTWIC::PeerClient ALIAS DARTWICPeerClient)
add_library(DARTWIC::EngineProtocolPeer ALIAS DARTWICPeerClient)
set_target_properties(DARTWICPeerClient PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME PeerClient)
target_link_libraries(DARTWICPeerClient INTERFACE TEMPEST::Peer DARTWIC::EngineProtocol)
install(TARGETS DARTWICPeerClient EXPORT DARTWICPeerClientTargets)
install(EXPORT DARTWICPeerClientTargets NAMESPACE DARTWIC:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/DARTWICPeerClient)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/DARTWICPeerClientConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/DARTWICPeerClientConfig.cmake INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/DARTWICPeerClient)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/DARTWICPeerClientConfig.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/DARTWICPeerClient)

write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/DARTWICPeerClientConfigVersion.cmake
    VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/DARTWICPeerClientConfigVersion.cmake
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/DARTWICPeerClient)
